label: L=9 copy step 1 (t=10) when the fed-back first token is v/w
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at exactly one position: the step right after the first copy output (recall_idx == 1, t = L+1), almost only for length-9 sequences (t=10: 99% of activations; 3 at L=8). The input at that step is the fed-back first original token, and its identity sets the magnitude: v gives 60% of activation mass and every top example, w comes next (14%), then z/s/q/n give weak tails. (L==9 & recall_idx==1) alone has recall 0.99 but precision 0.02. Adding in_tok in {v,w} gives dev F1 0.30, mass recall 0.72. Most L=9 sequences starting with v still stay below threshold. Neither the next output (orig(1)) nor digit count separated them cleanly, so the rest of the variation is unexplained. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, at other copy positions, or for L<=7.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=v (+4.74), orig4=0 (+2.64), orig5=0 (+1.95), orig4=c (+1.91), L=9 & t=10 (+1.81), t=10 & prev_tok=<DEL> (+1.81). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.23), orig1=t (-1.58), orig1=x (-1.44), orig5=v (-1.39).
